newsitem.title: FRANCE: EP approves 500 mln Ecus BSE aid package for farmers.
newsitem.headline: EP approves 500 mln Ecus BSE aid package for farmers.

text.p: A package of 500 million Ecus in emergency aid for farmers affected by the mad cow crisis won the approval of the European Parliament on Friday.
The package of aid proposed by the European Commission -- COM(96)606 -- will be drawn from the European Union's farm budget.
The Parliament has still to approve a Commission proposal to fund the stabilisation of the beef and veal sector in 1997 and 1998 -- COM(96)422.
Parliament's agricultural committee has asked the Commission to withdraw the proposal, which it deems unsatisfactory, and submit a proposal relating soley to financing in 1997.

The committee said it was not prepared to write the Counci a blank cheque for 1998 and said the decision should be taken as part of the Parliament's deliberations on the 1998 budget, which will not start until autumn 1997.
